decisions.reason: Hosting the marketing site on a subdomain does not change the selected Basic Webflow plan or the cheapest-plan selection rule.
The subdomain decision leaves the existing requirement for the root domain to continue serving the customer-facing product unchanged.
The marketing site's hosting subdomain does not change the login button placement or its external destination URL.
The hosting-domain change does not alter the Loom recording format or its site-editing instruction goal.
The subdomain decision does not change the Webflow website artifact or its handoff to the client's workspace.
The early-access action can continue navigating to the contact page regardless of the marketing site's selected subdomain.
The hosting subdomain does not change the required recipient email addresses or lead-delivery behavior.
The subdomain decision changes hosting location but not the landing page's content composition or screenshot-selection policy.
The marketing site's hosting subdomain does not change its visual aesthetic, brand-asset usage, or style reference.
